# Model trials

<!-- Generated by Scripts/model-trials.py from docs/model-trials.json. Edit the JSON, then run make model-trials. -->

Dates are the doc's own date, else the git date of the doc; `—` in Link means the result is not recorded in the repo. The same trials are published at https://typeme.it/models.

Three structural rules did: 2 of the 5 were dictionary words, 3 were a confident word carried into a term by an unsure neighbour (2 words each), and the run penalty cut multi-word meeting false matches 31 to 14. After: dictation WER 4.09% (plain Ultra 4.09%, was 4.67%), 0 false insertions real and synthetic, synthetic hits 64/90 (71%, was 70/90), real hits 0/2 (unchanged). Held-out: WER 3.57% both, 0 false, synthetic 35/49 (71%). Meetings: 14 false matches over 16,674 words against 2 for plain Ultra (99 before); 10 of the 14 come from stored aliases, and with aliases off it is 6.
